judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass SB 136, which gave police officers of the Alcohol, Tobacco, and Cannabis Commission the same collective bargaining rights most state employees have. Supervisors, managers and confidential staff were left out. The Maryland House of Delegates passed it 99-33 and it was signed into law as Chapter 65 of 2026.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing SB 136, which gave police officers of the Alcohol, Tobacco, and Cannabis Commission the same collective bargaining rights most state employees have. Supervisors, managers and confidential staff were left out. The Maryland House of Delegates passed it 99-33 and it was signed into law as Chapter 65 of 2026.
